name: CheckScreeningEligibility
title: Cervical Cancer Screening Assessment
description: Trigger Questionnaire — submits with no input. The associated PlanDefinition (CervicalCancerScreening) evaluates the Library CervicalCancerScreeningDecision against the selected Patient and creates a CarePlan if Is Eligible For Screening is true.

item.text: Submitting will evaluate cervical cancer screening eligibility for this patient using the CervicalCancerScreening PlanDefinition.
